WITH page_projects AS ( SELECT p.* FROM projects p WHERE
AND p.status = #{status}
ORDER BY ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_favorites pf WHERE pf.project_id = p.id ) ) DESC, p.updated_at DESC, p.id DESC
ORDER BY p.created_at ASC, p.id ASC ORDER BY LOWER(p.name) ASC, p.id ASC ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC, p.id DESC
OFFSET #{offset} LIMIT #{limit} ) SELECT p.id, p.name, p.description, p.cover_image_url, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_favorites pf WHERE pf.project_id = p.id ) AS starred, COALESCE(metrics.total_chapters, 0) AS total_chapters, COALESCE(metrics.total_scenes, 0) AS total_scenes, COALESCE(metrics.estimated_duration_seconds, 0) AS estimated_duration_seconds, chapter_progress.has_chapter AS has_chapter, chapter_progress.analysis_ready AS analysis_ready, canon_progress.canon_ready AS canon_ready, story_progress.story_ready AS story_ready, production_progress.production_started AS production_started, production_progress.production_ready AS production_ready, production_progress.editor_ready AS editor_ready, render_progress.render_in_progress AS render_in_progress, CASE WHEN render_progress.render_in_progress THEN 'RENDER' WHEN production_progress.editor_ready THEN 'EDITOR' WHEN production_progress.production_started THEN 'PRODUCTION' WHEN story_progress.story_ready THEN 'PRODUCTION' WHEN canon_progress.canon_ready THEN 'STORY' WHEN chapter_progress.analysis_ready THEN 'CANON' ELSE 'SOURCE' END AS latest_stage FROM page_projects p LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sv.id FROM story_versions sv WHERE sv.project_id = p.id AND sv.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'DRAFT') ORDER BY CASE WHEN sv.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, sv.version_number DESC, sv.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_story ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id)::int AS total_chapters, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id)::int AS total_scenes, COALESCE(SUM(s.duration_seconds), 0)::bigint AS estimated_duration_seconds FROM chapters c LEFT JOIN scenes s ON s.chapter_id = c.id AND s.storyboard_revision_id = c.current_storyboard_revision_id WHERE c.story_version_id = latest_story.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ) metrics ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chapters c WHERE c.story_version_id = latest_story.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ) AS has_chapter, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chapters c JOIN generation_jobs gj ON gj.chapter_id = c.id AND gj.job_type = 'CHAPTER_ANALYZE' AND gj.status = 'COMPLETED' AND gj.source_hash = c.source_hash AND gj.chapter_row_version = c.row_version WHERE c.story_version_id = latest_story.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ) AS analysis_ready ) chapter_progress ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT chapter_progress.analysis_ready AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_characters pc LEFT JOIN character_versions cv ON cv.id = pc.pinned_character_version_id WHERE pc.project_id = p.id AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (cv.id IS NULL OR cv.status <> 'LOCKED') ) AS canon_ready ) canon_progress ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT canon_progress.canon_ready AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chapters c JOIN scenes s ON s.chapter_id = c.id AND s.storyboard_revision_id = c.current_storyboard_revision_id JOIN story_beats sb ON sb.scene_id = s.id WHERE c.story_version_id = latest_story.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chapters c JOIN scenes s ON s.chapter_id = c.id AND s.storyboard_revision_id = c.current_storyboard_revision_id JOIN story_beats sb ON sb.scene_id = s.id WHERE c.story_version_id = latest_story.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND sb.review_status <> 'APPROVED' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chapters c JOIN scenes s ON s.chapter_id = c.id AND s.storyboard_revision_id = c.current_storyboard_revision_id JOIN visual_beats vb ON vb.scene_id = s.id WHERE c.story_version_id = latest_story.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chapters c JOIN scenes s ON s.chapter_id = c.id AND s.storyboard_revision_id = c.current_storyboard_revision_id JOIN visual_beats vb ON vb.scene_id = s.id WHERE c.story_version_id = latest_story.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND vb.review_status <> 'APPROVED' ) AS story_ready ) story_progress ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chapters c JOIN scenes s ON s.chapter_id = c.id AND s.storyboard_revision_id = c.current_storyboard_revision_id JOIN visual_beats vb ON vb.scene_id = s.id JOIN shot_sequences sq ON sq.visual_beat_id = vb.id JOIN shots sh ON sh.sequence_id = sq.id WHERE c.story_version_id = latest_story.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ) AS production_started, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chapters c JOIN scenes s ON s.chapter_id = c.id AND s.storyboard_revision_id = c.current_storyboard_revision_id JOIN visual_beats vb ON vb.scene_id = s.id JOIN shot_sequences sq ON sq.visual_beat_id = vb.id JOIN shots sh ON sh.sequence_id = sq.id JOIN selected_takes st ON st.shot_id = sh.id JOIN takes t ON t.id = st.take_id JOIN media_assets ma ON ma.id = t.output_asset_id WHERE c.story_version_id = latest_story.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.status = 'PASSED' AND t.validation_status = 'PASS' AND t.source_duration_ms > 0 AND ma.asset_type = 'VIDEO' AND ma.status = 'READY' ) AS editor_ready, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chapters c JOIN scenes s ON s.chapter_id = c.id AND s.storyboard_revision_id = c.current_storyboard_revision_id JOIN visual_beats vb ON vb.scene_id = s.id JOIN shot_sequences sq ON sq.visual_beat_id = vb.id JOIN shots sh ON sh.sequence_id = sq.id WHERE c.story_version_id = latest_story.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chapters c JOIN scenes s ON s.chapter_id = c.id AND s.storyboard_revision_id = c.current_storyboard_revision_id JOIN visual_beats vb ON vb.scene_id = s.id JOIN shot_sequences sq ON sq.visual_beat_id = vb.id JOIN shots sh ON sh.sequence_id = sq.id LEFT JOIN selected_takes st ON st.shot_id = sh.id LEFT JOIN takes t ON t.id = st.take_id LEFT JOIN media_assets ma ON ma.id = t.output_asset_id WHERE c.story_version_id = latest_story.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND (st.shot_id IS NULL OR t.status <> 'PASSED' OR t.validation_status <> 'PASS' OR t.source_duration_ms IS NULL OR t.source_duration_ms <= 0 OR t.output_asset_id IS NULL OR ma.asset_type <> 'VIDEO' OR ma.status <> 'READY') ) AS production_ready ) production_progress ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM generation_jobs gj WHERE gj.project_id = p.id AND gj.job_type = 'RENDER_PROJECT' AND gj.status IN ('QUEUED', 'SUBMITTING', 'SUBMITTED', 'RUNNING', 'UNKNOWN', 'RECONCILING', 'STALLED') ) AS render_in_progress ) render_progress ON TRUE
ORDER BY starred DESC, p.updated_at DESC, p.id DESC
ORDER BY p.created_at ASC, p.id ASC ORDER BY LOWER(p.name) ASC, p.id ASC ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC, p.id DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_favorites (project_id) SELECT p.id FROM projects p WHERE p.id = #{projectId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL ON CONFLICT (project_id) DO NOTHING
